name: Secrets Viewer
description: Browse the categorized secrets store (/app/data/secrets.json) as a themed, collapsible-by-category table - category, key, and when it was last set. Also lists known integrations (Pushover, Prowl, Paperless-ngx, Gitea) that don't have a value set yet - clearly marked as a hardcoded checklist, not file data, with a banner if secrets.json doesn't exist at all yet - so a missing secret is visible before a script fails on it. Values are never shown, not even partially - only a character-count hint. Use Secrets Manager to add, update, or delete an entry.
